name: Geotrichum Fruit Rot of Cucurbits
symptoms: Soft watery rot on fruits White cottony mold on infected areas Fruit tissue becomes soft and collapses Sour or fermented smell from infected fruit Rot usually starts at wounds or damaged areas
description: A fungal disease that causes soft rot on cucurbit fruits such as cucumber, melon, and pumpkin. It mainly affects ripe or damaged fruits and produces a white mold that later becomes sour and watery.
management: Handle fruits carefully to avoid wounds Remove and destroy infected fruits Improve field and storage sanitation Ensure good ventilation during storage Harvest fruits at proper maturity
prevention: Avoid fruit injuries during harvest and transport Maintain clean storage conditions Remove plant debris from fields Store fruits in cool and dry conditions
